body: Worker trap (Termal::Opus3, 2026-11-13, docs items w-7845 and w-1474): two claims must not name the same worktree as their source root. A registered launcher run there is refused at registration: HTTP 409 "ambiguous named roots … Clear the earlier name or use separate worktrees". When one candidate serves two items, give each claim its own worktree, for example a second detached checkout at the same commit. Also: before running any launcher command on Central, check that Opus2 hasn't announced an EXCLUSIVE window, because the launcher spawns git for the commit identity even when registration then refuses.
